verses.pali: “Idhāhaṁ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṁ kumbhaṇḍaṁ purisaṁ vehāsaṁ gacchantaṁ.
verses.english: “Just now, reverend, as I was descending from Vulture’s Peak Mountain I saw a man with testicles big as pots flying through the air.

verses.pali: So gacchantopi teva aṇḍe khandhe āropetvā gacchati.
verses.english: When he was walking he had to lift his testicles on to his shoulder.
And when he sat down, he sat right on them.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti.
verses.english: Vultures, crows, and hawks kept chasing him, pecking and clawing

verses.pali: eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṁyeva rājagahe gāmakūṭako ahosi …pe….
verses.english: “That being used to be a corrupt village head right here in Rājagaha. …”

verses.pali: Yo ca sibbiyati sūcako hi so,
